title: Thinking Fair and Slow: On the Efficacy of Structured Prompts for Debiasing Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the StereoSet dataset by comparing the probabilities of generating stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentences, and the Regard dataset by using a classifier to measure the social perception (regard) of generated text for male versus female demographics.

Evaluated using the StereoSet dataset to compare probabilities of stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical associations, and the Regard dataset to measure the social perception of generated text for Black versus White demographics.

Evaluated using the StereoSet dataset by calculating a Stereotype Score (SS) that measures the fraction of times a model assigns a higher probability to a stereotypical sentence over an anti-stereotypical sentence regarding religion.
Evaluated using the StereoSet dataset by comparing the language model's assigned probabilities for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical words in fill-in-the-blank templates about professions.
Evaluated using the Regard dataset by employing a classifier to compute a regard score, measuring the social perception of generated text for Gay versus Straight demographics.
